Extract every email address from the text; output lowercased, sorted, comma-joined.

```python
import re
def solve(text)
```

# Skill: extract-emails
Extract every email address from the text; output lowercased, sorted, comma-joined.
Handles any casing.

```python
import re
def solve(text):
    found = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", text)
    return ",".join(sorted({f.lower() for f in found}))
```
